newsitem.title: USA: Smith Barney sees normal temps in U.S. Northeast.
newsitem.headline: Smith Barney sees normal temps in U.S. Northeast.

text.p: Smith Barney meteorologist Jon Davis said he sees normal temperatures for the U.S. Northeast and most of the United States for the next four to five days.
But, he said temperatures should trend slightly cooler in those regions by the weekend and into next week.
"It should be pretty normal for the next four to five days and then it should trend cooler over the weekend but nothing exceptionally cold," said Davis.
Weather Services Corp forecasted temperatures should be near or slightly above normal in the Northeast Tuesday and Wednesday and remain that way for the rest of the week.

The northeastern region of the United States is the largest heating oil market in the world. Prices of heating oil futures on the New York Mercantile Exchange were lower Monday on the temperature forecasts as they signalled weakening demand, traders said.
